paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Paper derives a solar energy-loss limit (La < 0.1 Lsun from SNO all-flavor 8B neutrino flux) giving g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1, Eq. (4). This is a mass-independent bound stated to apply to sub-keV mass particles (solar core T ~ 1 keV), encoded as a flat line from effectively massless up to ~1 keV. The paper also derives boson-electron Yukawa limits (PS: 2.8e-11, S: 2.4e-13, V: 1.7e-13 at mchi=0, with mass dependence shown only in Fig. 1 up to ~10 keV), but the primary/hinted result is the axion-photon coupling. No CL is explicitly stated for the solar limit (described as a 'nominal limit'); 0.95 given as default.
